title: New Workflow Text Proto & Publish Validation
summary: Application Integration now supports a `WORKFLOW_TEXTPROTO` file format for specific upload/download operations, enabling a new way to manage integration definitions. Additionally, a `validateOnly` option has been added to the publish request, allowing pre-flight checks without actual deployment.
details:
Developers can now leverage a new `WORKFLOW_TEXTPROTO` enum value for the `fileFormat` parameter across several download methods, including `projects.locations.integrations.versions.download`, `projects.locations.integrations.versions.testCases.download`, `projects.locations.products.integrations.versions.download`, and `projects.locations.templates.download`. This format is also available in `fileFormat` properties for `GenerateOpenApiSpecRequest`, `UploadIntegrationVersionRequest`, `UploadTemplateRequest`, and `UploadTestCaseRequest`. Note that this format is currently restricted to allowlisted projects for integration version upload and download.

For improved deployment safety, the `GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaPublishIntegrationVersionRequest` now includes an optional `validateOnly` boolean parameter. Setting this to `true` will perform a validation check on your integration version's configuration without actually publishing it, preventing unintended state changes or deployments of invalid configurations.
